readout: continuous one-token P(YES) normalized against NO
treatment_boundary: No construct name, criterion label, rubric, or enumerated quality list appears in a G target prompt.
target_orbit_rule: Average the three frozen community/practitioner/naturalistic frames; retain per-frame scores, information, variance, flips, and independent-launch test-retest.

forms.prompt: Would the intended audience regard this as a successful joke overall?
Taking the judgment as a whole, would a veteran comedy practitioner say that this joke works?
If encountered in its natural audience setting, would this be received as a joke that works overall?
Would the intended reading community regard this creative-writing submission as successful overall?
Taking the judgment as a whole, would an experienced writing-workshop practitioner say that this submission works?
If encountered as a real submission by its intended readers, would this piece be received as working well overall?
Would communications professionals regard this as an effective and professionally acceptable press release overall?
Taking the judgment as a whole, would an experienced communications practitioner say that this press release works?
If encountered in ordinary professional use, would this be accepted as an effective press release overall?
Would the relevant mathematical community regard this as a high-quality answer to the question overall?
Taking the judgment as a whole, would an experienced Math Stack Exchange participant say that this answer works?
If encountered as a real response in its mathematical community, would this be received as a successful answer overall?

claim_boundary: G is a large-model holistic informant policy, not a social-practice target P and not ground truth.
